output.summary: KEP-668 proposes building support for the out-of-tree GCE cloud provider, including a well-tested cloud-controller-manager with feature parity to the kube-controller-manager. Its status is provisional.
output.rationale: The KEP addresses the need to run GCE clusters with an out-of-tree cloud-controller-manager rather than in-tree GCE provider code. It defers the broader motivation to the Cloud Controller Manager KEP and explicitly excludes removing the in-tree GCE code, which falls under the separate in-tree removal KEP. The provided excerpt gives no detail on design choices or review outcomes beyond these goals.

alternatives.option: Remove in-tree GCE cloud provider code as part of this KEP
alternatives.why_not: The readme places this under a separate KEP: "Removing in-tree GCE cloud provider code, this effort falls under the KEP for removing in-tree providers" is listed as a non-goal.

evidence.quote: Build support for the out-of-tree GCE cloud provider. This involves a well-tested version of the cloud-controller-manager that has feature parity to the kube-controller-manager.
This KEP is specifically tracking progress for the GCE cloud provider.
Removing in-tree GCE cloud provider code, this effort falls under the [KEP for removing in-tree providers]
